answer: Skill fingerprint proof stops sybil aliases in an agent economy. A new alias must finish 6 jobs across 4 different skill tags before it can post paid offers, and each job record carries a falcon dispatch code plus a jade receipt signed by the buyer. The registry keeps an ember log of every fingerprint, so identical skill sequences across aliases stand out at once. Each week auditors check a random 5 percent of fingerprints, and an alias caught reusing another alias work history loses its posting rights for 14 days and pays a 40 POA fine per fake alias.
